drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our proposed first-round revision. We have clarified the permitted use and handling of confidential information, added customary exclusions and compelled-disclosure language, and clarified the duration and remedies. Please let us know your thoughts.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE AND USE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction (the “Purpose”) and may disclose Confidential Information to one another in connection with the Purpose. The receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely to evaluate, negotiate, or pursue the Purpose, and shall not use it for any other purpose or disclose it except as expressly permitted by this Agreement.
edits.name: Purpose and Use

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION; PROTECTION. “Confidential Information” means information disclosed by or on behalf of a party or its representatives, whether before or after the date of this Agreement, in any form, that is marked confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. The receiving party shall protect Confidential Information using at least reasonable care and no less than the care it uses to protect its own similarly sensitive information. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its and its affiliates’ directors, officers, employees, financing sources, and professional advisors who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties at least as protective as this Agreement; the receiving party is responsible for their compliance. These obligations do not apply to information the receiving party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is received lawfully from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to Confidential Information. A combination of information is not excluded merely because individual elements are public or otherwise excluded. The receiving party may disclose information to the extent required by law or legal process, provided that, where legally permitted, it gives prompt notice to the disclosing party and reasonably cooperates, at the disclosing party’s expense, in seeking confidential treatment.
edits.name: Confidential Information; Protection

edits.text: 3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. The obligations concerning each item of Confidential Information continue for five years from its disclosure; provided that obligations concerning information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law continue for so long as it remains a trade secret. Expiration or termination of this Agreement does not affect obligations that have accrued or continue under this Section.
edits.name: Term; Survival

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES; NO LICENSE. A breach or threatened breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity, without waiving any requirement to establish entitlement to such relief. No disclosure grants the receiving party any license or other rights in the Confidential Information, except the limited right to use it for the Purpose under this Agreement.
edits.name: Remedies; No License

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is the revised draft, including a mutual obligation to return or destroy Confidential Information upon request or termination of discussions, with a narrow retention exception for legal, compliance, and routine backup purposes subject to continuing protection. We believe this addresses your request and look forward to turning the draft promptly.

edits.text: 5. RETURN OR DESTRUCTION. Upon the disclosing party’s written request or upon termination of discussions concerning the Purpose, the receiving party shall promptly, at the disclosing party’s election, return or destroy the disclosing party’s Confidential Information in its possession or control, including copies and notes that contain or reflect such information, and, upon request, confirm its compliance in writing. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the receiving party may retain (a) copies required to be retained by applicable law, regulation, or bona fide document-retention requirements, (b) one archival copy held by its legal or compliance personnel solely to document its compliance with this Agreement, and (c) copies contained in routine electronic backup systems, provided such copies are not readily accessible in the ordinary course and are not restored or accessed except as required for disaster recovery or legal compliance. Any retained Confidential Information remains subject to this Agreement for so long as retained and may not otherwise be used or disclosed.
edits.name: Return or Destruction
